report.summary: Ordered work items: fix budget-tracking gap in fanout.py (gate 0), verify dominance denominator in markdown.py (gate 0), confirm DEFAULT_NUM_CTX in switches.py (gate 0), inspect early-return logic in checks.py (gate 1), assess duplicate identity evasion in actor ID hashing (gate 2).
risks: Budget-tracking gap: missing 'paid_calls' in success path may cause KeyError in callers.
Dominance fraction denominator may be inflated if code_modules includes documents.
DEFAULT_NUM_CTX missing would cause NameError at runtime.
checks.py may apply incorrectly to non-Python files, causing false positives/negatives.
Duplicate identity evasion is low severity but could allow undetected duplicates.
todos: Fix fan_out() in fanout.py to include 'paid_calls' in success return.
Inspect code_modules in markdown.py to confirm filtering of non-code files.
Search for DEFAULT_NUM_CTX definition in switches.py; add if missing.
Inspect checks.py functions for file extension early returns; add if missing.
Review actor ID generation to ensure full config hash is included.

items.title: Fix budget-tracking gap in fanout.py
items.why_now: Confirmed high-severity inconsistency: success path omits 'paid_calls' key, risking KeyError in callers that expect consistent schema.

steps.do: Add 'paid_calls' key to successful return dict in fan_out() function, consistent with refusal return.
steps.verified_by: Run grep -rn 'paid_calls' daedalus/lanes/fanout.py and confirm both return paths include the key. Then run tests/test_lanes_fanout.py to ensure no regression.

items.assumption: The exact location of fan_out() return statements is assumed to be in daedalus/lanes/fanout.py. If not, adjust.

items.title: Inspect code_modules in markdown.py to verify document filtering
items.why_now: High-severity finding: if code_modules does not filter out non-code files, dominance fraction denominator is inflated, skewing metrics.

steps.do: Read daedalus/structcore/markdown.py and inspect code_modules function for filtering logic.
steps.verified_by: If filtering exists, document it. If not, add filtering to exclude non-code files. Run tests/test_markdown_nodes.py to verify.

items.assumption: code_modules function is in markdown.py; if not, locate and adjust.

items.title: Confirm DEFAULT_NUM_CTX definition in switches.py
items.why_now: Medium-severity: if constant is missing, NameError occurs at runtime when referenced.

steps.do: Search for 'DEFAULT_NUM_CTX' in daedalus/mapping/switches.py. If missing, add the constant with appropriate default value.
steps.verified_by: Run grep -n 'DEFAULT_NUM_CTX' daedalus/mapping/switches.py to confirm presence. Run tests/test_mapping_switches.py.

items.assumption: The constant should be defined in switches.py; if imported from elsewhere, verify import exists.

items.title: Inspect early-return logic in checks.py for non-Python files
items.why_now: Medium-severity: if early-return logic is incomplete, checks may be applied incorrectly to C/C++ files, causing errors.

steps.do: Inspect functions parses, not_truncated, no_elision, not_substituted in daedalus/lanes/checks.py for file extension checks.
steps.verified_by: If missing early returns, add checks to skip non-Python files. Run tests/test_lanes_checks.py and test with a C file fixture.

items.assumption: The functions are in checks.py; if not, locate and adjust.

items.title: Assess duplicate identity evasion in actor ID generation
items.why_now: Low-severity but could allow duplicate actors to evade detection if hash collision occurs.

steps.do: Review actor ID generation code to ensure it includes a hash of the full configuration (model, temperature, etc.), not just model name.
steps.verified_by: Search for 'actor.id' or 'def id' in relevant files. Run tests with identical configs to verify IDs match.

items.assumption: Actor ID generation is likely in daedalus/council/ or daedalus/providers/; need to locate exact file.
